settings.heading: A few quiet minutes, on your schedule
settings.body: No clinic, no appointments. Each kit comes with everything you need for a hygienic at-home routine, plus a step-by-step guide. Refrigerate on arrival, rotate sites, and let your skin and body do the rest.

Glutathione is a tripeptide made from three amino acids and is the body's master antioxidant, found in every living cell. Levels fall with age, stress, sun exposure and modern life, which can show up as dullness, uneven tone and low energy.

Replenishing glutathione supports brighter, clearer skin, natural detoxification and immune defence. Delivered subcutaneously, it bypasses the digestive system for high bioavailability, so your cells can put it to work quickly.
settings.insight: Glutathione neutralises free radicals and recycles other antioxidants such as vitamins C and E. It also helps regulate tyrosinase, the enzyme behind melanin production, which is why it is prized for a brighter, more even complexion.

settings.heading: High bioavailability, visible results
settings.body: Oral glutathione is largely broken down in digestion. Delivered subcutaneously, it reaches your system directly, so more of the active goes to work on brightness, detox and antioxidant defence.

settings.note: For adult use only. Consult your practitioner before beginning glutathione therapy, particularly if pregnant, breastfeeding or managing a health condition.

settings.q: How soon will I see results?
settings.a: Many people notice a brighter, fresher complexion and more energy within a few weeks. Glutathione works best taken consistently across the full protocol.

settings.q: How often should I use it?
settings.a: Follow the protocol in your kit, typically a small subcutaneous dose two to three times a week. Each vial provides multiple doses.

settings.q: Why injection instead of a capsule?
settings.a: Oral glutathione is largely broken down in digestion. Subcutaneous delivery bypasses the gut for much higher bioavailability, so more of the active reaches your cells.
It can sting slightly and small bruises are not unusual. Take the vial out of the fridge about 30 minutes beforehand, insert at a 45 degree angle just under the skin, and rotate sites each time.
Subcutaneously, just under the skin into fatty tissue. The stomach, hips or buttocks work well. Rotate the site with each dose.

settings.q: Who is glutathione not suitable for?
settings.a: Not suitable for anyone under 18, or with an allergy to glutathione or sterile solutions. Please speak to your doctor first if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have a serious health condition.
Most people notice none. Occasionally there can be mild sensitivity at the injection site. If that happens, choose a different site next time, and stop if anything feels unusual.
Refrigerate the vial for optimal freshness. It also stays stable at room temperature for a short period, so a day in transit is no problem.
Discreetly and tracked across the UK, packed with a cool pack to keep it in perfect condition. A Certificate of Analysis is available on request.
